sources.snippet: The runner does not switch on model family. Already-distributed Laya GGUFs (english / multilingual / typed-decisions) predate that key. If ggmlc.decision is missing, laya.exe assumes the built-in Laya preprocessor so existing downloads keep working. Do not ship any non-Laya GGUF without ggmlc.decision.
